feeds.title: Momma Lew
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Reesa Lewandowski, Momma Lew, a New Jersey food and lifestyle blogger. As the mom of 2, I love making the lives of moms easier through recipes and women's lifestyle content.

feeds.title: Mom Home Guide
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to my blog! I'm Lauren, a mom who is passionate about her family, loves to write, read and make her home the best it can be. Mom Home Guide is a mom blog, who shares tips on home decor, crafts, gardening and recipes.

feeds.title: Mamabee
feeds.description: Mamabee is a daily dose for women and family's lifestyle site founded by Meghna Deshraj that covers healthy tips, style, design, culture, food, travel, relationships, and parenting.

feeds.title: Mommy University
feeds.description: I am Jessica Lopa, a full-time school psychologist, wife to an amazing husband and mother to 2 incredible boys. Mommy Univerisity blog is a blog created to provide parents with the tools and information needed to enhance their child's development in all areas like social, emotional, communication, motor skills and more.

feeds.title: Wine in Mom
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Julia, a South Jersey girl who enjoys wine, travel, Disney and the sometimes humorous but always heartfelt side of motherhood. I started Wine In Mom in February of 2011, 6 weeks after I had my son Jackson. Wine In Mom started as a place for me to share my experiences as a new mom. My goal has always been to share my life in a relatable and honest way. My blog community inspired me to become more active in my local community, I am the president of my local MOMS Club.

feeds.title: Johanny's Kitchen
feeds.description: My name is Johanny Casillas. I'm a mother, wife, daughter and sister. I started this blog as a way to share recipes. But don't be fool by the name, Johanny's Kitchen is a place where I share not only recipes, but ideas, tips and of course a LOT of pictures.

feeds.title: Amadison Mom Australia Blog
feeds.description: Colleen lives in New Jersey with her husband, Nick, and daughters Zoe and Ana. She began writing at A Madison Mom in March of 2007. It was very much a 'mommy blog'... all about her adventures as a new stay-at-home mom. In 2016, she decided to change it up a little. She wants to share information with the other families here (or thinking of moving here) about the local schools, restaurants, businesses, and events.

feeds.title: South Jersey Mom
feeds.description: South Jersey MOM has been publishing for 15 years. We are a resource that connects families with local businesses, helping both grow with our 30 years of marketing experience. The tools we offer are top in the industry.
